component.name: eMuleBB Rust
component.summary: Search, download and share files over eD2K and Kad

description.p: eMuleBB Rust is a peer-to-peer file sharing client for eD2K and Kad. Search for files, manage downloads and share folders from the browser console.
The desktop launcher starts the daemon and opens its local WebUI in your default browser when available. Use the authenticated REST API to automate supported client operations.
